newsitem.title: TURKEY: Ford may up stake in Turkish Otosan venture.
newsitem.headline: Ford may up stake in Turkish Otosan venture.

text.p: Industrial conglomerate Koc Holding said it and Ford Motor Co began talks to equalise equity stakes in their car and commercial vehicle production joint venture Otosan Otomobil Sanayii.

If the partners agree, Koc group -- the major shareholder with a 50.5 percent share -- will sell part of its equity stakes to Ford which holds a 30 percent stake in Otosan, Koc said in a statement. Koc family has also a 3.36 percent share in Otosan.
In the statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange, Koc Holding said the partners aimed to strengthen their partnership in Otosan which produces commercial vehicles and passenger cars.
The Holding said no purchase of Otosan shares from the stock market would be made when equalising stakes.
It added that Otosan's marketing arm Otosan Pazarlama would merge with Otosan.
Otosan's provisional net profit had surged to six trillion lira in January-September 1996 from 1.3 trillion in the same 1995 period.
